race_context: Knox Community School Corporation is based in Knox, the Starke County seat, and runs three schools: Knox Community Elementary, Knox Community Middle School and Knox High School, plus a virtual school {kcsc_home}{kcsc_supt}{nces_knox}. Federal data list 1,673 students in 2024-25 {nces_knox}. Greg Mikulich is superintendent {kcsc_supt}{wkvi_jan2025}.

The Board of School Trustees has seven members {kcsc_board}. Seats are tied to townships: the three seats on the 2026 ballot are one each for California, Center and Washington townships, and candidates must live in the township they seek to represent {wkvi_filing_2026}. Each race elects one member, matching the state list's 'vote for 1' {wkvi_filing_2026}{in_list}. In the 2022 county results each of the three township races drew roughly 2,600 votes {starke_2022}.

Who holds the seats now: all three incumbents are on the ballot. Jason Downs won the California Township seat in 2022, Gary Dulin kept the Center Township seat and Erin Duff won the Washington Township seat {wkvi_results_2022}{wkvi_sworn_2023}. The other four members (Kirk Bennett, Wendy McIntire, Autumn Ferch and Dr. Thomas Browne) were elected in November 2024 {wkvi_jan2025}. The district website lists Bennett as president, Downs as vice president and McIntire as secretary {kcsc_board}.

Rematches from 2022: the California and Center township races repeat 2022 contests. Downs beat Mary Lynn Ritchie 1,329 to 1,303 (50.49% to 49.51%), and Dulin beat Raymond Stephenson 1,392 to 1,259 (52.51% to 47.49%) {starke_2022}. Duff beat Michael Yankauskas 1,387 to 1,235 in Washington Township {starke_2022}.

Party labels: 2026 is the first partisan school board election under the new state law; candidates could list a party or none, there was no primary, and straight-ticket voting does not apply to these races {wkvi_filing_2026}. WKVI's ballot list shows Downs, Stephenson, Duff and Brooke Norem as Republicans, Julie Berndt as a Democrat, and Ritchie and Dulin with no party; the state lists Ritchie and Dulin as Nonpartisan {wkvi_election_central}{in_list}. Both Washington Township candidates are Republicans {wkvi_election_central}{in_list}.

Budget and pay (fall 2026): the board's Oct. 12, 2026 agenda included a public hearing on the proposed 2027 budget, Capital Projects Fund plan and Bus Replacement Fund plan, setting an Oct. 26 adoption meeting, a $1-per-hour raise for classified staff and $3 more in the daily base rate for bus drivers (both retroactive to July 1, 2026), a one-time $100 classroom supply stipend for teachers, and a telehealth benefit for employees not eligible for the district's health insurance {wkvi_budget_1012}. The board held a work session for a fiscal review on Jan. 26, 2026 {wkvi_jan26}. This guide found no reporting on how the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1) affects Knox's budget, and no operating or safety referendum.

Safety: in September 2024 the board passed a resolution to create a school corporation police department; Mikulich said the assistant principal had been serving as safety director and 'We want one person in charge of our schools and our school safety' {wkvi_police_2024}. A school safety handbook was on the May 4, 2026 agenda {wkvi_may4}.

Facilities: construction at Knox High School was a recurring agenda item in 2025-26, with an update on an upcoming high school project on Jan. 5, 2026 and an update on upcoming construction projects on May 4, 2026 {wkvi_jan5_2026}{wkvi_may4}. The Oct. 12, 2026 agenda included a bid recommendation for the pool air handling unit {wkvi_budget_1012}.

Academics: at Knox Community Elementary in 2025, 38.8% of tested students were proficient on ILEARN English/language arts, 45.9% in math, and 85.1% passed the IREAD-3 reading test {idoe_kce}. This guide did not find corporation-wide grades.

Board recognition: the Indiana School Boards Association gave the board an Exemplary Governance Award for 2025, based mainly on members' training and goal-setting; Browne, Downs and Ferch received individual awards {wkvi_isba_2026}.
Forums: this guide found no 2026 candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage of the candidates' views for this race.
